faqs.a:
The city council finds that it is necessary to establish a single procedure for the
               filing of liens on private property to collect amounts due and owing to the city for
               payment of city services not otherwise collected. It is the intention of the city
               council in adopting this chapter to comply with section
5.7
of the Arvada City Charter which requires an article to place any burden upon private
               property.
(
Ord. No. 4042, § 1, 12-11-2006
)
